up: Retrieve the exact activity values and chemical structures for compounds tested in assay CHEMBL4808150. Return the compound's ChEMBL ID or canonical SMILES, along with the exact standard value, standard units, and standard relation. Filter for exact measurements only (standard_relation = '='). Do not apply any row limits or additional filters.
sql: SELECT md.chembl_id AS compound_chembl_id, cs.canonical_smiles, a.standard_value, a.standard_units, a.standard_relation FROM assays aas JOIN activities a ON aas.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno JOIN compound_structures cs ON a.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE aas.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL4808150' AND a.standard_relation = '='
